items.title: The upper shriek functors compose up to a canonical isomorphism on bounded below complexes
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement produces a transformation b^! o a^! -> (b o a)^! for finite type homomorphisms A -> B -> C of Noetherian rings and asserts that it is an isomorphism on bounded below complexes (author lemma at source lines 4774-4779, label lemma-composition-shriek-algebraic). The proof (source lines 4781-4813) factors the situation through a polynomial ring over A mapping onto B together with a presentation of C over it, applies the base change statement for the surjection onto that presentation, uses adjointness to restriction to identify the shriek of the composite surjection, and closes the displayed chain of identifications with the double base change statement (proof lines 4800-4812). The factorization and the chain of identifications are the substance. H3.
